#Could automate this but dont want too


#Co-Optimized


Techtype <- c('Storage', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Storage', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Generation')
elc_capacitydf_coop <- cbind(elc_capacitydf_coop,Techtype)



for(i in 1:nrow(elc_capacitydf_coop)){
  
if(elc_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == 'Individual'){
  elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/32
}
  
if(elc_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
  elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/32
}
  
  if(elc_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
  elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/320
}

  if(elc_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
  elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- elc_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/3200
}
}



Techtype <- c('Generation', 'Generation', 'Storage', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Storage', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Storage', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Generation', 'Storage')
water_capacitydf_coop <- cbind(water_capacitydf_coop,Techtype)



for(i in 1:nrow(water_capacitydf_coop)){
  
if(water_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == 'Individual'){
  water_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- water_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/32/1000
}
  
if(water_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
  water_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- water_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/32/1000
}
  
  if(water_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
  water_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- water_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/320/1000
}

  if(water_capacitydf_coop[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
  water_capacitydf_coop[i,2] <- water_capacitydf_coop[i,2]/3200/1000
}
}


elc_capacitydf_coop$Scenario <- factor(elc_capacitydf_coop$Scenario, levels = c('Utility', 'Individual', '32 Houses', '320 Houses', '3200 Houses'))
water_capacitydf_coop$Scenario <- factor(water_capacitydf_coop$Scenario, levels = c('Utility', 'Individual', '32 Houses', '320 Houses', '3200 Houses'))


ec1 <- ggplot() + geom_bar(data = elc_capacitydf_coop, aes(x = Techtype, y = Capacity, fill = Technology), stat = 'identity' )+
 facet_wrap(~Scenario)+
  #theme_minimal()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'), legend.position = 'bottom', legend.text = element_text(size = 7.5), legend.title = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 8), axis.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = 'bold'),legend.key.width = unit(0.1, 'in'), legend.key.height = unit(0.1,'in'), legend.margin = margin(t = 0, unit = 'cm'), plot.margin = unit(x = c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5), units = 'mm'))+
labs(title = 'Co-Optimized', y = 'Average Installed Electricity Capcacity (kW)', x = '')+
  scale_fill_manual(labels = c("H_PV" = "RFT-PV", "C_PV" = "COM-PV", "C_WND" = "WIND", "C_HB" = "HBRD", "Utility" = "E-UTIL", 'H_BAT' = 'IND-BAT', 'C_BAT' = 'COM-BAT'), values = c("H_PV" = "#A6CEE3", "C_PV" = "#1F78B4", "C_WND" = "#B2DF8A", "C_HB" = "#33A02C", "Utility" = "#CAB2D6", 'H_BAT' = 'chocolate', 'C_BAT' = 'chocolate4'))+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,9))+
  guides(fill=guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

  facet_wrap(~Scenario)+

costdf_util[1,2] <- 'Utility'
fracdf_util[1:2,3] <- 'Utility'
colnames(fracdf_coop)[1] <- 'Technology_Fraction'
colnames(fracdf_util)[1] <- 'Technology_Fraction'
costdf <- rbind(costdf_util[1,],costdf_coop)
fracdf <- rbind(fracdf_util[1:2,], fracdf_coop)
costdf$Scenario <- factor(costdf$Scenario, levels = c('Utility', 'Individual', '32 Houses', '320 Houses', '3200 Houses'))
costdf$Scenario




cg1 <- ggplot() + geom_bar(data = costdf, aes(y = Dollars, x = Scenario, fill = Scenario), stat = 'identity') +
  geom_point(data = fracdf, aes(y = Value*4000, x = Scenario, shape = Technology_Fraction), size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~./3800, name = ''), limits = c(0,4000))+
  theme_minimal()+
  
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = 'bold'), legend.position = 'top', legend.text = element_text(size = 8), legend.title = element_blank(), axis.title = element_text(size = 8), axis.text = element_text(size = 8), axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),legend.key.width = unit(0.06, 'in'), legend.key.height = unit(0.06,'in'), legend.margin = margin(t = 0, unit = 'cm'), plot.margin = unit(x = c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5), units = 'mm'))+
  labs(title = 'Co-Optimized', y = 'Dollars ($)', x = '', size = 8)+
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2")+

#Emissions
emit_water_coop <- rbind(prod_waterdf_util[1,],subset(prod_waterdf_coop, prod_waterdf_coop$Tech == 'Utility'))
emit_water_coop$resource <- c(rep('Water',nrow(emit_water_coop)))
#3.78541 kL (m^3) / kGal 396 kWh / m^3 0.85 lb CO2 / kWh
emit_water_coop$emission <- round((emit_water_coop$`1`/264.172*0.51*0.85*0.907185/2000+emit_water_coop[1,2]/264.172*0.51*0.85*0.907185/2000),3)

emit_water_water <- rbind(prod_waterdf_util[1,],subset(prod_waterdf_water, prod_waterdf_water$Tech == 'Utility'))
emit_water_water$resource <- c(rep('Water',nrow(emit_water_water)))
emit_water_water$emission <- round((emit_water_water$`1`/264.172*0.51*0.85*0.907185/2000+emit_water_water[1,2]/264.172*0.51*0.85*0.907185/2000),3)

emit_water_elc <- rbind(prod_waterdf_util[1,],subset(prod_waterdf_elc, prod_waterdf_elc$Tech == 'Utility'))
emit_water_elc$resource <- c(rep('Water',nrow(emit_water_elc)))
emit_water_elc$emission <- round((emit_water_elc$`1`/264.172*0.51*0.85*0.907185/2000+emit_water_elc[1,2]/264.172*0.51*0.85*0.907185/2000),3)

emit_elc_water <- rbind(prod_elcdf_util[1,],subset(prod_elcdf_water, prod_elcdf_water$Tech == 'Utility'))
emit_elc_water$resource <- c(rep('Energy',nrow(emit_elc_water)))
#0.85 lb CO2 / kWh 2000 lbs / ton  1 ton / 0.907185 metric ton
emit_elc_water$emission <- round(emit_elc_water$`1`*0.85*0.907185/2000,2)

emit_elc_coop <- rbind(prod_elcdf_util[1,],subset(prod_elcdf_coop, prod_elcdf_coop$Tech == 'Utility'))
emit_elc_coop$resource <- c(rep('Energy',nrow(emit_elc_coop)))
emit_elc_coop$emission <- round(emit_elc_coop$`1`*0.85*0.907185/2000,2)

emit_elc_elc <- rbind(prod_elcdf_util[1,],subset(prod_elcdf_elc, prod_elcdf_elc$Tech == 'Utility'))
emit_elc_elc$resource <- c(rep('Energy',nrow(emit_elc_elc)))
emit_elc_elc$emission <- round(emit_elc_elc$`1`*0.85*0.907185/2000,2)


emit_coop <- rbind(emit_water_coop,emit_elc_coop)
emit_water <- rbind(emit_elc_water, emit_water_water)
emit_elc <- rbind(emit_water_elc,emit_elc_elc)



emit_coop$Scenario <- factor(emit_coop$Scenario, levels = c('Utility', 'Individual', '32 Houses', '320 Houses', '3200 Houses'))

emit_water$Scenario <- factor(emit_water$Scenario, levels = c('Utility', 'Individual', '32 Houses', '320 Houses', '3200 Houses'))

emit_elc$Scenario <- factor(emit_elc$Scenario, levels = c('Utility', 'Individual', '32 Houses', '320 Houses', '3200 Houses'))

emit_coop
emit_water
emit_elc

table(emit_coop$resource, emit_coop$Scenario)
